scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic. The exact random-quantile cdf composition gives the RAI multiplier; universal invariance reduces to a first-order differential equation whose complete cdf solutions are the power laws \(G(u)=u^a\) with \(a>0\). No numerical experiment is used as evidence for the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The uniqueness theorem assumes an absolutely continuous strictly increasing randomizer cdf on (0,1) with positive density almost everywhere and absolutely continuous nonnegative parent laws. It does not classify singular or discrete randomizers, nor every pair of randomizers that might preserve one specially chosen parent comparison.
title: Beta-power randomizers are exactly the universal RAI invariants
